author: M3
usage: Inject `classes` into the A1 system prompt. Model returns an array of {code, span, why} — advisory only, never blocks publishing.

classes.label: No baseline
classes.description: The notice describes a problem but does not state the current measured situation.
classes.example_bad: People are facing long waiting times.
classes.example_good: People currently wait an average of 60 minutes for the service.

classes.label: KPI not measurable
classes.description: Uses general words like improve or increase without explaining how the improvement will be measured.
classes.example_bad: Improve the quality of public services.
classes.example_good: Reduce the average complaint resolution time from 10 days to 5 days.

classes.label: Solution presupposed
classes.description: Names a solution instead of describing the problem, which rules out approaches the market might offer.
classes.example_bad: Develop a mobile app to reduce citizen complaints.
classes.example_good: Reduce the number of unresolved citizen complaints by 30%.

classes.label: Specification tailored to one supplier
classes.description: Requirements are written in a way that favours a particular company, product or technology.
classes.example_bad: The solution must use ABC Company's platform.
classes.example_good: The solution should handle 10,000 cases per month, regardless of the technology used.

classes.label: Outcome not attributable
classes.description: Even if the situation improves, nothing establishes that the solution caused it rather than seasonality or another change.
classes.example_bad: Reduce waiting time during the festival season.
classes.example_good: Reduce waiting time against the same period last year, measured at a comparison site that does not receive the solution.

classes.label: No success threshold
classes.description: Does not state what result would count as success, so the pilot cannot fail.
classes.example_bad: The solution should improve service efficiency.
classes.example_good: The pilot succeeds if processing time falls by at least 25%.

classes.label: Timeline not feasible
classes.description: The time allowed is unrealistic for the work described, or no timeline is given at all.
classes.example_bad: Develop and fully implement the system within 3 days.
classes.example_good: Develop the pilot within 8 weeks, followed by 4 weeks of testing and evaluation.
